verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is a library and CLI, so its public API is its programmatic bindings and scriptable command line. The evidence shows official API bindings for C, C++, Python, .NET and Node.js (docs-5), positions the product for integration into applications (docs-11), and documents an official CLI with a scripting-first design (probe-4, docs-4); community reports confirm scripted, programmatic use. The missing OpenAPI spec is expected for a non-web-service library and does not count against it. missing for 10: in-depth API reference content in the evidence (only marketing-level claims of the bindings), independent corroboration of the language bindings in practice, machine-readable markdown docs (docs-md probe 404).
